title: 2017 HMMT February Guts Problem 6
statement: Let \(A B C D\) be a convex quadrilateral with \(A C=7\) and \(B D=17\). Let \(M, P, N, Q\) be the midpoints of sides \(A B, B C, C D, D A\) respectively. Compute \(M N^{2}+P Q^{2}\)

solutions.text:
Answer: 169
\(M P N Q\) is a parallelogram whose side lengths are 3.5 and 8.5 so the sum of squares of its diagonals is \(\frac{7^{2}+17^{2}}{2}=169\)
